clues: This startup reached a $1 billion valuation within months of its founding in 2024.
In 2025, it released a commercial world-generation model named Marble to create interactive 3D environments.
Its research focuses on spatial intelligence and generating synthetic simulation environments for physical AI.
Two of its research leaders guiding its 3D foundation model efforts are Justin Johnson and Ben Mildenhall.
This company was co-founded by Stanford professor and ImageNet creator Dr. Fei-Fei Li.
AMD agreed to acquire this spatial intelligence startup in an all-stock deal valued at $8.2 billion.
